public_health_question.v: How was a case of pneumonic plague, initially suspected to be COVID-19, diagnosed and investigated in Wyoming?

ev.q: This investigation highlights challenges associated with diagnosis and treatment of an illness from a rare pathogen whose symptoms mimic those of a pandemic illness
Diagnosis and Investigation of Pneumonic Plague During a Respiratory Disease Pandemic — Wyoming, 2021
WDH was notified of a suspected case of pneumonic plague in an adult who was admitted to a Wyoming hospital
WDH reviewed medical records, collaborated with hospital infection preventionists, and interviewed the patient’s friends, family members, neighbors, and work colleagues.
